rationale: The candidate reads coherently across all four views as one stepped, bent bar with a clear dominant mass and a meaningful carved void. The silhouette is more a capacity-bearing terraced section than a mere code-minimum stack, so it scores well on silhouette resolution. The parcel response is plausible: the mass sits within the green boundary without simply filling it, and the open figure is legible. The blue frontage edge is not sealed; the ground condition suggests an entry seam/void response, though it is not maximally expressive. Program-wise it can support neighborhood living/mixed-use as a compact urban building with active ground and hierarchical upper mass, but the current section still feels slightly generic and could better emphasize a public threshold or clearer inhabitable terrace/courtyard logic.
